findings.note: The Devils' official preview says New Jersey (2-3-0) plays the second night of a back-to-back in Detroit, less than 24 hours after a 4-1 home loss to Ottawa, which could favor rested Detroit.

ESPN lists Detroit at 1-3-1, 1-3 at home, scoring 2.00 goals per game and having lost 4 of its last 5. Kasper, Appleton and Compher are on IR and Edvinsson is out. Gibson has a .862 save percentage, and the page does not confirm tonight's starting goalie.
ESPN's scoreboard shows the market close to even, with DET at -115 and NJ at -105 on the moneyline. That is in line with the offered -110 and does not point to a price discrepancy.
